consequence.statement: KVStoreMesh will be enabled in Clustermesh unless explicitly disabled by setting clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false; this changes the default behavior of the cluster mesh configuration.

original.statement: KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default in Clustermesh; environments that do not explicitly set clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false will have it enabled after the upgrade.

decision.reason: [ev-12660f87be40] says only that KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default and can be turned off with clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review) is the right consequence. The values files [ev-28e0ccb5774a] [ev-39a22d88e2f5] confirm the default moved from false to true. Known fact vf-29c7813c0106 already records this exact change for release 1.16.0, with the same subject, before/after values, applicability and a behavior-change consequence, so this item duplicates it.
